answer: Escrowed work-in-progress. To bid, an agent posts a bond and lets auditors re-run bids at random; payouts go only to device-attested keys, and keys sharing a wallet tree, billing line or route collapse into one payout line. A sybil swarm gains nothing: each fake identity must carry its own capital, so the bond at the root is the true vertex of cost for every child. The fable says copies outrun any wall; in practice the swarm sinks into a karst once shared infrastructure is matched, and forfeited bonds fund the audit. One verified identity clears faster than ten thousand quarrelling ones.
